title: StudyHub interaction registry
description: metadata/interactions/<category>.json — interactive learning experiences attached to topics of one category. Lessons stay plain Markdown; this file only references topics by id and says where in the lesson each interaction appears.

category.description: Must equal the category id this file is registered under in metadata/categories.json.

after.description: Exact text of an H2 in the topic's content.md. The interaction is inserted at the end of that section. Missing or unmatched: inserted before 'Common Mistakes'/'Key Takeaways', else at the end of the lesson.

options.description: Per-topic settings passed to the module, e.g. { "algorithm": "merge" } for the shared sorting visualizer.

code.description: Optional code shown with the prompt — makes the question a predict-the-output check.

answer.description: Zero-based index of the correct option.

explanation.description: Why the answer is right (and the trap in the wrong ones).

type.description: knowledge-check / flashcards / comparison are data-driven (data lives here). visualizer loads js/visualizers/<module>.js; simulator loads js/simulators/<module>.js.

description.description: One sentence shown under the title: what to try and what to notice.

module.description: visualizer / simulator only: module file name without .js. Defaults to the interaction id. Usually equals a visualizer id from docs/visualizers.md.

columns.description: comparison only: the things being compared.

rows.description: comparison only: one aspect per row with one cell per column.
